research_report_declare_gate_syntax.title: research-report-declare-gate-syntax
research_report_declare_gate_syntax.content:
report_declare reconcile gate enforces two strict syntax rules:
1. NUMBER ATTRIBUTION: Every numerical value in REPORT.md must carry a (P#) tag referencing a metric_recompute output. Raw values from world_observe or world_simulate have no P# provenance and MUST be converted to prediction bands (e.g., [15, 22]) or qualitative statements. Only metric_recompute return values may appear as attributed numbers.
2. CONCLUSION LINE FORMAT: Hypothesis status lines (typically in Section 5) must EXACTLY match the register format: '- H{N}: {STATUS}' with NO trailing text, em-dashes, parenthetical probe references, or descriptions. Extra text causes case-insensitive string mismatch against the register. Place explanatory context in surrounding prose, not on the status line itself.

refinements.trigger: Capture report_declare gate syntax constraints to prevent recurring reconciliation failures in this research session.
refinements.evidence: The trajectory shows two failed report_declare attempts due to (1) unattributed numbers from world_observe/simulate and (2) hypothesis status lines with trailing descriptions not matching the register. These are strict, repeatable syntax rules for the research-report workflow that will apply to any subsequent report declarations in this session.
refinements.outcome: Future REPORT.md drafts in this session will comply with reconcile gate on first attempt, avoiding wasted edit-declare cycles. Validate by checking that next report_declare passes reconcile without number-attribution or conclusion-format errors.
